newsitem.title: NORWAY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF DOWNHILL WINNER LASSE KJUS.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF DOWNHILL WINNER LASSE KJUS.

text.p: profile of the winner of Sunday's men's World Cup downhill:
World Cup wins: 7. Downhill - Kvitfjell (97), Kvitfjell (96),
Bormio (95), Giant slalom - Kranjska Gora (95), Super-G - Vail
Other facts: Won combined gold at 1994 Olympics. Came back from
sinus infection that kept him out of competition for one month
to win three silver medals (downhill, giant slalom, super-G) at
1997 world championships in Sestriere, Italy. Won gold in
Born and raised near Oslo. Father built small slope near their
home and taught his son to ski.
